mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, target_amt, saved_amt, start_date, status, create_time FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY status ASC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal (user_id, name, target_amt, saved_amt, start_date, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{targetAmt}, #{savedAmt}, #{startDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET name = #{name}, target_amt = #{targetAmt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE goal SET saved_amt = #{savedAmt}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
